goal: Autonomously search a bounded public library candidate pool, establish verified read-only external connections, use external metadata to select a library, inspect a cryptographically verified distribution artifact, discover an unprovided dependency, and follow that dependency through a second external registry connection.

search_protocol.objective: select a Python library for parsing HTML/XML/markup content

claim_boundary: Bounded autonomous public read-only library discovery and verified second-hop connection only. Candidate pool, objective, host allowlist, safety caps, and admission gates remain host-authored. No unrestricted internet autonomy, general intelligence, consciousness, or G3 claim.
